lines.description: Number of measurements to perform before quitting.

heat.description: Force the CPU to run a busy loop of that many microseconds before starting measurements.

count.description: Loop count value to be used as a starting point.

only_cpu_freq.description: Only report the CPU frequency in MHz (-c).

only_tsc_freq.description: Only report the TSC frequency in MHz (-t).

integer_freq.description: Truncate the frequency to the nearest integer value (-i).
